text:
alex: Quick sync — proposing a short "integration lab" next week to run compatibility / smoke tests across LangChain, LlamaIndex, gateway adapters, and one orchestration tool. Goal = pass/fail matrix + basic perf regressions. Owners?
maria: Love this. Suggested test matrix: basic generation, streaming, function-calls, embeddings, quantized runs, KV-cache persistence. Keep it small and repeatable.
sam: I can own LangChain + adapter harness. I'll sketch a runner and expected flags. Example local runner:
```
./run_smoke.sh --adapter langchain --model redwood-v1 --tests basic,streaming,embeddings
```
I'll drop a gist with runner + expected outputs.
jordan: I'll loop in partner PMs (FlowForge, ChainForge, GatewayHub) — need to confirm NDAs for sharing logs. Also we should align on marketplace announcement cadence if partners want co-announce. Timeline idea: 2-week sprint, then partner signoff -> joint blog/marketplace entry.
tina: For SDK surface I'll add tests for streaming incremental tokens + function-call schemas. Will PR fixtures into infra/testbeds repo (small, self-contained).
ci-bot: Created Trello board "integration-lab/sprint-0" and added tasks: #23 integrate-langchain-harness, #24 gateway-adapter-smoke, #25 lindex-compat-check.
alex: Thx. We also need infra: a short reserved slot for dedicated GPUs (quantized runs) Mon-Wed next week. Can someone ping eng-infra oncall to reserve? We should avoid noisy multi-tenant tiers.
maria: Please add a quantization smoke (8-bit) and a KV-cache warmup step — those fail silently often. Also add a small sample prompt set per adapter.
sam: Agree. Also propose pass criteria: accuracy within 5% of baseline (toy eval), latency <200ms p50 for basic gen, no function-call failures on schema validation. I'll draft a short "acceptance.md" and add to board.
jordan: I'll prepare partner comms + marketplace checklist (legal approvals, co-branding assets, listing metadata). Will coordinate with marketing after partners OK.
alex: Owners summary: sam = LangChain/adapter harness, tina = SDK/tests, maria = test matrix & data, jordan = partner comms/marketplace, alex = infra coordination. Kickoff meeting Monday 11:00am PT. I'll send calendar invite and @channel ping.
maria: RSVP'd.
sam: +1. Gist link when ready: https://gist.github.com/example/run-smoke (WIP).
jordan: I'll DM partner PMs to confirm availability and NDA status.
alex: One more ask — record a short runbook for reproducing a failing adapter locally (helps partners run tests too).
tina: Will add runbook to the PR.
alex: Cool. :thumbsup:
